This creamy soup showcases the sweetness of vegetables in a veritable taste explosion.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Veggie Cream Soup}}
This creamy soup showcases the sweetness of vegetables in a veritable taste explosion.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can [[Cooking|Cook]] Veggie Cream Soups by combining either a [[Fortified Pumpkin]] or any [[Carrot]] with [[Fresh Milk]] and [[Rock Salt]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made by using multiple [[Vegetable]]s with contradicting effects. Eating them will heal some of Link's [[Heart]]s. These Soups are known to showcase the sweetness of Vegetables. When Link speaks to [[Koko]] at her Cooking Pot for the first time, she will explain that she wants to make Veggie Cream Soup for dinner, since she hears it is nourishing and fortifying.{{Cite|Today's dinner is {{Color BotW|Blue|veggie cream soup}}! It's super nourishing and fortifying! Well, that's what they say, anyhow. It must be true!|Koko|BotW}} She explains the [[Recipe]] involves stewing a [[Swift Carrot]], Rock Salt, and Fresh Milk in a pot.{{Cite|All you do is toss a {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrot}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|rock salt}}, and {{Color BotW|Blue|fresh milk}} in a pot and stew it up. Then, voilà! So yummy!|Koko|BotW}} However, Koko realizes that she does not have any Swift Carrots, and she laments the fact that she promised Veggie Cream Soup to her sister [[Cottla]].{{Cite|{{Big|...OH, NO!}} Koko is all out of {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrots}}! But...Koko promised to make Cottla some {{Color BotW|Blue|hasty veggie cream soup}}...|Koko|BotW}} Link can offer to bring her some,{{Cite|[I'll bring you some.] Thank you! So much! OK, Koko just needs one {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrot}}! Just one and Koko can get cookin'! Koko will be waiting for you here!|Koko|BotW}} which initiates the [[Side Quest]] "[[Koko's Kitchen]]". If Link brings Koko a Swift Carrot, Koko will be thankful and proceeds to make Veggie Cream Soup.{{Cite|[This is for you.] {{Big|Is that...a {{Color BotW|Blue|swift carrot}}?!}} Thank you so much! So very much! Now Koko can make dinner for Cottla... Yeah! Time to get cookin'!|Koko|BotW}} As a reward, she will give Link Hasty Veggie Cream Soup.{{Cite|Ooooh, it came out perfect! Here, please have some! Koko's treat!|Koko|BotW}} Three different variations of Veggie Cream Soup can be made, depending on the type of Vegetable used: * '''Enduring Veggie Cream Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Veggie Cream Soup}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This creamy soup showcases the sweetness of vegetables in a veritable taste explosion.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Carrot]]s. When eaten, these soups will completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Veggie Cream Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Veggie Cream Soup}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This creamy soup showcases the sweetness of vegetables in a veritable taste explosion.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using Swift Carrots. They can be eaten to provide a boost to Link's movement speed. * '''Tough Veggie Cream Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Veggie Cream Soup}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This creamy soup showcases the sweetness of vegetables in a veritable taste explosion.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using Fortified Pumpkins. If eaten, they increase Link's [[Defense]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Veggie Cream Soup can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Fresh Milk]] and a piece of [[Rock Salt]] with any type of [[Carrot]] or [[Pumpkin]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cream of Vegetable Soup * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Soups |items= BotW, TotK }}
